evidence_class: Static: retained C4 cut plus current controller/interface/lib/physical-adapter source inspection; no build, test, candidate replay, numerical execution, physical run, target run, or source edit
scope: C4 typed-kind verification, minimal controller success/failure accounting propagation, refinement-refusal metadata, and guard-event grouping

c4_kind_fix.evidence: RefinementBvls02Outcome includes kind: Option<M1TrustRegionRefusalKind>; crossing and success set None; both refusal arms set Some(refusal.kind); the ineligible control compares the complete outcome structure.

controller_findings: ControllerRun sums only successful proposal_trace observations. A failing transition returns through ?, losing all earlier successful proposal accounting from the returned value.
A successful Stage1 solve can be followed by phase, evaluator, hydraulic, merit, materialization, or numerical failure before a transition is pushed; its accounting is then lost.
phase_model can execute both a predictor subproblem and a reassembled subproblem. The returned transition retains only the final model observation, so proposal_trace also undercounts successful runs.
The physical adapter installs controller_run only on success and its run observation omits all refinement and whole-KKT/enclosure counters.
minimal_controller_augmentation: Add one shared accounting value to FoundationState. It contains the refinement-cap counters and the distinct whole-solve KKT/enclosure counters; do not derive a unique total by adding overlapping domains.

Make solve_proposal/proposal_model mutable. Immediately after solve_subproblem returns, absorb an Ok observation or Err refusal into FoundationState accounting before any predicted-reduction, phase, evaluator, or materialization work. This records predictor and reassembled solves independently.

On Stage1 Err, absorb the partial refusal accounting and return the unchanged M1TrustRegionControllerError::Subproblem owner. On Stage1 Ok, absorb accounting before continuing and retain the ordinary observation for behavior.

At controller entry boundaries, wrap failure as { source: M1TrustRegionControllerError<E>, accounting }. The source enum remains unchanged and inspectable. Initialization failures carry zero accounting; transition, post-update, and reassembly failures carry the current FoundationState accounting. Apply the same rule to the single-transition test seam.
On success, populate M1TrustRegionControllerRun from FoundationState accounting rather than proposal_trace sums. Keep proposal_trace as behavioral trace only; do not fabricate a failed transition.

Augment the existing physical adapter observation with the same accounting value. Explicitly match controller Ok/Err, store accounting on both paths, and return the unchanged source inside the failure wrapper. Preserve the existing final budget snapshot behavior.

refinement_refusal_metadata_gap.current_gap: M1TrustRegionSubproblemRefusal has generic kind, overloaded optimality reason/coordinate/radius/lambda, and four refinement totals. refinement_refusal sets only optimality_reason. It cannot identify correction position, guarded primitive stage, exact coordinate context, masks, face radii, or rejected p1 box status.
minimal_record: Add optional typed refinement metadata only for TrustRegionRefinementIndeterminate; all non-refinement refusals keep None and their current owner kind.
Retain the stable refinement reason without reusing an optimality-only label.
Record correction_position as Option<1|2>; use None for eligibility work before correction 1.

Record a guarded-stage enum: source operand, primary product, splitter product, split output, EFT remainder, TwoSum result, TwoSum remainder, accumulation, factor output, coordinate update, active value, box check, or radius check.
Record coordinate when applicable and residual row/term indices for residual/Dot2 failures so the actual guard site is attributable.
Record original lower/upper active masks, lambda, input trust radius, reduced face radius when distinct, and p1 scratch-box-feasible as Option<bool> once p1 exists.
Attach the same shared accounting snapshot. Construct metadata at the actual guard site and propagate it; do not infer stage or coordinate later from the stable reason string.

guard_event_grouping.verdict: One event per semantic operand/result admission, not one per boolean predicate.
rules: A binary operation has at most three guard events: left operand admission, right operand admission, and rounded-result admission.
Finite, zero-underflow, and subnormal tests within one result admission are alternative classifications of that one event.
A unary operation has at most operand and result admissions. A source reused by a later operation is admitted again for that later operation.
Dot2 exceptional_guards is a diagnostic subset/tag of a guard already present in total guards; it is not added again.
p0/p1/p2 seam events follow the fixed E(m) semantic checks; individual boolean clauses do not create extra events.
guard_event_grouping.reason: This preserves the accepted G(m)=3*K(m)+E(m) bound while still counting every guarded source/result stage.

residual_review_obligation: Review the frozen implementation for immediate absorption of every Stage1 result, predictor plus reassembled solve coverage, prior-plus-current failure totals, exact owner preservation, physical observation on Err, and full typed refinement metadata.
